name: workspace_prepare
description: Create or resume a run-owned branch from repoPath (or clone repoUrl), always suffixing new outcome branches with the stable execution ID. Includes every Git-visible existing change in the branch baseline without moving the source branch; inPlace switches to the new branch before committing. Nested workspacePath reuses the parent branch unchanged.

inPlace.description: If true, create/switch to a run-owned branch inside repoPath itself and commit its Git-visible changes as the baseline. Mutually exclusive with createPr=true.

createPr.description: Must be false when inPlace is true; inPlace execution is local-only.

branchRunId.description: Stable execution ID used to derive the run-owned branch/worktree name. Falls back to workflowId, then the task's workflow instance ID.

workflowId.description: Fallback run ID used when branchRunId is not supplied.

branch.description: Requested branch/outcome-branch name; a run-suffix is appended for isolated runs.

workspacePath.description: Existing worktree path to inherit unchanged (nested-workflow case). When set, no new branch or worktree is created.

repoPath.description: Path to an existing local git checkout to use as the source. Required (directly or via repoUrl) unless workspacePath is supplied.

repoUrl.description: Repository URL to clone when repoPath is not supplied and workspacePath is not inherited.

cloneDest.description: Destination directory for a fresh clone when repoUrl is used. Defaults to a /tmp path derived from the run ID.

expectedRepos.description: Repository identifiers the local checkout's remotes must match (skipped when a fresh clone was just made). Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

fetchSource.description: Optional remote/URL to fetch fetchRefspec from directly, without changing the source repo's remote config.

fetchRefspec.description: Optional refspec to fetch from fetchSource (or 'origin' if fetchSource is omitted) before snapshotting.

materializedSourcePaths.description: Path roots (relative) to flag as 'materialized' in the output when they appear among the source's changed files. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

preserveExisting.description: If true and a worktree for this run already exists, reuse it instead of recreating it.

sourceRepoPath.description: Resolved absolute path of the source repository.

worktreePath.description: Path to the checkout the workflow should operate in (equals sourceRepoPath when inPlace).

baseCommit.description: Commit SHA the workflow should treat as its starting point.

originalBranch.description: The branch the source checkout was on before preparation.

originalHead.description: The source checkout's HEAD commit before preparation.

sourceHead.description: The source checkout's HEAD commit (same as originalHead).

baselineCommit.description: Commit capturing the source's Git-visible changes at prepare time.

baselineCreated.description: True if a new baseline commit was created; false if an existing one was reused or none was needed (inherited path).

baselineIncludedPaths.description: Paths included in the baseline snapshot/commit.

statusFingerprint.description: InPlace only: hash of the checkout's working-tree status after the baseline commit.

ignoredSourcePaths.description: Always empty; reserved for future use.

materializedSourcePaths.description: Changed source paths that fall under one of the requested materializedSourcePaths roots.

owned.description: True only when this call created a fresh run-level worktree it is responsible for cleaning up.

resumed.description: True if an existing worktree/workspace for this run (or inherited workspace) was reused rather than newly created.

sourceCloned.description: True if repoUrl was cloned to produce the source checkout.
